KJV 6:9 'This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night' is *haec solidi sacrificii lex esto: victima in rogo super ara esto totam noctem*, Wikisource's 6:8–9; its 6:7 *Porro Aharoni … praecipito, inquit:* is the KJV's 6:8 (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 6:13 'The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out' is *igni semper in ara inexstincto ardente* at the end of Wikisource's 6:12 (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 6:14 'And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD' is Wikisource's 6:13–14 (*Ferti autem lex haec esto: qui de filiis Aharonis id coram Jova … libabit,*) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 6:19 'And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying' is *De libamine autem Aharonis, aut ejus filiorum, inquit,*; KJV 6:20 'This is the offering of Aaron … which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed' begins at *quod Jovae libabunt quo die ungentur* (as Exod 30:17) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)
